stage2_results.local_context:
The recall notice in China covers a total of 183,211 vehicles from the Tang and Qin series. The issue is a defect in the material of a stopper pad attached to the brake pedal. Because of a manufacturing problem, the pad may crack or break over time.

This is where the message mix-up with the lights can happen. In an extreme case, the pad may come off, and the brake lights may stay on even when the pedal is not being pressed. The car behind then gets a signal that does not match what the driver is doing. This is the wrong signal that the notice points to as a safety concern.

To be clear, the notice is not saying that the brakes may stop working. It says that what the driver does with the brake pedal may not match what the lights show. When we think of car safety, we tend to focus on big actions such as moving, turning, and stopping. But on the road, signals that tell others “what is happening now” are also essential.

To be clear, the notice is not saying that the brakes may stop working. It says that what the driver does with the brake pedal may not match what the lights show. When we think of car safety, we tend to focus on big actions such as moving, turning, and stopping. But on the road, signals that tell others “what is happening now” are also essential.
